packageRules.description: New OpenWrt point releases (see README 'Updates and releases'): open the PR as soon as the tag is published and merge it straight away. Merging triggers the build workflow, which publishes the next v<version>-<N> release. There are no PR checks to wait on (the build only runs on main), hence ignoreTests. Major series bumps (e.g. 25.x -> 26.x) still wait for a human, since package names change between series.

Digest-only rebuilds of the same imagebuilder tag: don't publish a new image revision for these. The OpenWrt version is unchanged, so a new release would only create noise for anyone tracking releases of this repo.
